messages:
sam: heads up — noticed during staging rollout that the bulk role-edit API can elevate viewer -> editor when filters include project:null. Repro on staging. :warning:
anya: omg, thanks. which endpoint?
sam: POST /api/admin/roles/bulk-edit { filter: {project: null}, changes: [{op: 'add', role: 'editor'}] }
kevin: that's the new 'project-scope' expansion we merged yesterday. Might be missing the explicit validation for null vs undefined.
elaine: does audit log show who triggered it? i can't find entries in kibana for that request id.
sam: no audit event recorded for that request. grabbed controller logs, snippet below:
```
2026-03-20T15:02:11.123Z INFO bulkEditController requestId=req_8f3f user=kev action=bulk-edit filter={project:null} changes=[editor]
2026-03-20T15:02:11.125Z WARN bulkEditService scope=null short-circuiting kms-sign
```
kevin: ugh — looks like the code path short-circuits KMS signing when scope is null. that explains missing audit signature entries.
ops-bot: deploy 17432 -> prod started by @kevin :rocket:
jordan: we should pause rollout. @oncall-bot can you hold the job?
oncall-bot: pausing deployment, creating incident INC-2026-042 :rotating_light:
kevin: rolling back the canary and patching the bulk-edit handler to require a non-null scope and to always call the kms signer. pushing hotfix now.
anya: test plan for hotfix? we'll need to backfill audit events and scan for any users incorrectly promoted to editor.
sam: quick scrub query to find potential affected rows:
```sql
SELECT user_id, role, scope, count(*) AS hits
FROM role_assignments
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-20'
  AND role = 'editor'
  AND scope IS NULL
GROUP BY user_id, role, scope;
```
elaine: run it and paste results here, i'll kick off the permission-scrub script to revoke mistaken editor roles. also need to produce a signed audit replay for any changes.
jordan: also check KMS-wrapped audit keys — we rely on KMS to sign audit entries; if the kms client wasn't invoked that explains absent entries in audit-logs.
kevin: confirmed: bulk-edit flow used `if (!scope) return;` which treats null as falsy and bypasses the kms.sign call. changing to `if (scope === undefined) return;` and adding an explicit guard that rejects null.
anya: long-term: add unit tests for kms invocation and an integration test that validates signed audit entries for each mutation. filing SEC-3217 to track.
sam: i'll run the scrub and create the remediation list for INC-2026-042. will also prepare a short comms note for any customers with admin consoles exposed.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-042 created (severity: medium) owner=kevin responders=[sam, elaine, anya]
kevin: ETA for hotfix + deploy: ~45m. tagging @security for review. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
security-bot: reminder — schedule an audit replay and signature verification for the window 2026-03-20T14:50:00Z..2026-03-20T15:10:00Z. priority=high.
jordan: after hotfix we should gate the console UI: disable bulk-edit button until a scope is explicitly selected. avoids accidental null filters. who owns console gating?
elaine: product-ui owns the gating. i'll ping @product-ux and add a follow-up task in the incident.
sam: final note: example of the failing check that caused the bypass: `if (!scope) return;` should have been `if (scope === undefined) return;` — our codebase uses null as an explicit unscoped value.
kevin: good catch. patch includes fix + extra logging + kms instrumentation test.
anya: thanks all. keep updates in this thread and add the remediation checklist to the incident ticket.
